name: stack-design
description: Choose, compare, review, and evolve application technology stacks from real constraints.

interface.shortDescription: Choose the simplest stack that satisfies real constraints.
interface.longDescription: Analyze requirements, constraints, team context, deployment reality, and existing code before choosing a technology stack. Explain selected and rejected options, confidence, risks, migration cost, and measurable evolution triggers.
defaultPrompt: Choose the simplest sufficient stack for this project.
Review this repository before adding a new technology.
Compare these stack options and explain the trade-offs.
